Build #2: adding FOSS apps, Bliss Touch Mapper, and basic addon_init.rc for touch & display mapping services ### Display Overrides (Displays 0 to 3) Use these to forcefully configure external monitors or built-in screens. - persist.ax86.display.<ID>.resolution:…
### Touchscreen Mapping (Slots 1 to 4)
Use these to map physical USB touchscreens to specific displays or fix inverted input axes.
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.vendor: USB Vendor ID (hex, e.g., 27c6).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.product: USB Product ID (hex, e.g., 0118).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.display: Target display ID (e.g., local:0, local:1, or none to unmap).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.orientation: Hardware rotation of the digitizer (0, 1, 2, 3).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.flip_x: Invert X-axis (1 or true).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.flip_y: Invert Y-axis (1 or true).
- Apply Changes: setprop sys.ax86.touch.update 1

XR Launcher 0.1.34

Spatial workspace launcher for Android XR glasses, tablets, and large-screen hosts — with the phone as a companion touchpad.

Tag: v0.1.34 · versionCode: 35 · minSdk: 34

This build lands companion multitouch, tray/QS polish, Recents world-lock, wallpaper/HDRI options, and clearer host look modes on tablet.

Highlights:
- Companion touchpad
- Apps icon toggles All Apps on glasses (replaces the wide Close All Apps button)
- 2-finger drag scrolls under the glasses cursor; pinch zooms the Home Space sphere
- 3-finger drag pans look; 2-finger tap right-clicks
- Toolbar icons use high-contrast tints on the dark chrome
- Tray / notifications / QS
- Deduped quick-settings chrome; brightness slider no longer trapped by a parent clickable
- Mouse-look can scrub brightness and a notification scroll handle
- Per-notification X dismiss hits for FPS / companion pointer
